lines.text: The Lord sends seventy-two ahead of Him two by two and tells them to carry no purse or bag or sandals.
Jesus tells them to say 'Peace to this house' and to heal the sick in welcoming towns.
Jesus says it will be more bearable for Gomorrah than for an unwelcoming town, and Capernaum will be brought down to Hades.
The seventy-two return with joy, and Jesus says they should rejoice that their names are written in Jerusalem.
Jesus praises the Father for revealing these things to little children, and says many prophets and kings did not see what the disciples see.
